description: This file defines the 'Notification' controller class within the Opencart admin tool namespace. It manages notification listings, details, and deletions in the admin panel.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class handling notification management in the admin panel, including listing notifications, viewing details, and deleting notifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the notification page, loads necessary language, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the notification view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or sub-requests to return the list of notifications.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches paginated notifications, formats their time difference, and returns the rendered notification list view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific notification and marks it as read.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications if the user has permission, returning JSON status.
